text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel claims 1st place in the 
Tenno Sho (Spring). Though she missed out 
on victory, it was truly a fantastic race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Spreading the Marvelous through 
racing"... Marvelous Sunday's 
long-cherished wish was firmly conveyed to 
the hearts of her rivals as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Each of them fixes their sights on a new 
destination. We should do our best too, 
heading toward the Takarazuka Kinen, the 
finale of the Spring Senior Triple Crown.
